propositions: Inbound status writes in apply_inbound_events.py bypass the parent-first cascade, allowing closed parents to have active children, violating the I4a invariant.

The cascade decision (_CASCADING_EDGES and _resolve_parent_in_status) must be single-sourced from rebar._commands.transition and applied at the inbound write surface, not routed through transition_compute.
When an inbound status change moves a child into an active status, eligible ancestors must receive their STATUS events in topmost-first order before the child's write.
Same-status inbound STATUS writes must be suppressed as no-ops to prevent duplicate events when a cascaded parent update conflicts with the parent's own inbound mutation in the same batch.
The inbound-reconcile write surface must maintain the invariant that no non-terminal-state ticket is a child of a closed ticket, matching the interactive cascade invariant.
